exposure: proposed algorithm for CSP management (including uterine artery embolization (UAE), fetal reduction, systemic methotrexate (MTX) injections, prophylactic UAE)
cohort: The study included 44 patients with confirmed cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) by transvaginal ultrasonography.
finding: The proposed stepwise algorithm for CSP management resulted in accountable outcomes, low hysterectomy rates, and fertility preservation.
followup_time: 3.6 months (for resolution of pregnancy remnant), and follow-up for subsequent pregnancies/recurrent CSP is implied but not explicitly stated as a duration.
gest_age: 7.37 ± 1.57 weeks (at the time of CSP diagnosis)
